entities.text: Md. Ramjan Ansari @ Md. Ramjan @ Ramjan
entities.label: PETITIONER

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned A.P.P. for the State.

2. The petitioner seeks bail, who is in custody since 25.01.2023 in connection with Mahila P.S.Case No.03 of 2023, F.I.R. dated 22.01.2023 registered for the offence punishable under Sections 341,354,376,504,506/34 of IPC and Section 4 of POCSO Act.
3. Allegation against the petitioner is that he committed rape upon the informant.
4. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has clean antecedent and he has falsely been implicated in the present case.

Further submits that the allegation as alleged in the FIR is false and fabricated and Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.26376 of 2023(3) dt.20-07-2023 the petitioner has not committed any offence as alleged in the FIR.

Furhter submits that the date of occurrence as alleged in the FIR is 17.01.2023 but the present FIR has been instituted on 22.01.2023 after delay of five days without giving any explanation of delay.
5.

Learned APP for the State, on the other hand, has vehemently opposed the prayer for bail of the petitioner and submits that the statement of the victim under Section 164 Cr.P.C. was recorded in Md. Ramjan Ansari @ Md. Ramjan @ Ramjan vs The State Of Bihar on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/135901813/
1 which she has categorically stated that the petitioner has committed rape upon her and as per the medical report of the victim is concerned, the same was conducted on 25.01.2023.
6.

entities.text: Md. Ramjan Ansari @ Md. Ramjan @ Ramjan vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Considering the aforesaid facts, I am not inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail in connection with Mahila P.S.Case No.03 of 2023 pending in the court of learned Special Judge (POCSO)-cum-Additional Sessions Judge-VI, Araria.

(Rajesh Kumar Verma, J) Nitesh/-
U T Md. Ramjan Ansari @ Md. Ramjan @ Ramjan vs The State Of Bihar on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/135901813/
